mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password, nickname, enabled, plan_id, plan_expire_at, created_at, last_login_at FROM vpn_user WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, email, password, nickname, enabled, plan_id, plan_expire_at, created_at, last_login_at FROM vpn_user WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vpn_user (email, password, nickname, enabled, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, 1, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE vpn_user SET last_login_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE vpn_user SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.nickname, u.enabled, u.plan_expire_at AS planExpireAt, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vpn_device d WHERE d.user_id = u.id) AS deviceCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vpn_session s WHERE s.user_id = u.id AND s.status = 'online') AS onlineCount FROM vpn_user u
AND (u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.id DESC
